notes.title: The Talking Bundle: Coffee Talk Episode 2 x Tavern Talk Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/bd847c0cd6bebdf11949925972c2d5c965dac1df.png[/img]

[h3][b][i]A game bundle about brewing drinks and talking with quirky characters[/i][/b]![/h3]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i][/h3]
[b]Celebrating the release of Tavern Talk on 20 June, we decided to do "The Talking Bundle" collab, please do check it out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/7dd1fb100448c9ea30038d04ce444d94da3aa02e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]About Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly[/b][/h3]
A direct continuation set a few years after the first episode. This is a heart-to-heart talking simulator where you interact with unique characters, including familiar faces from the first episode and new ones with their own set of challenges. Step back into the role of the Barista, serving drinks with new ingredients to mix and creating new, out-of-this-world coffee (and tea) recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/e96db2bede5aba4e650e4e35575c05c6bd6d189a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]About Tavern Talk[/b][/h3]
Gentle Troll Entertainment presents their latest game, Tavern Talk, a cozy visual novel about running a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Where the Coffee Talk series took place in a cafe in an alternate modern city of Seattle with fantasy characters, Tavern Talk took place in a tavern in a fantasy land called Asteria. Meet colorful cast of characters inspired from TTRPGs, serve them magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

Whether you want to serve a cup of coffee or mix magical drinks, we've got you covered in The Talking Bundle. In both Coffee Talk Episode 2 and Tavern Talk, you can always talk to your patrons and listen to their stories. Find your family among your diverse customers who aren't always human, and help them find a place that feels like home.

[h3][b]Grab the Talking Bundle here! [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42289/The_Talking_Bundle/

[i]The Talking Bundle discount is underway with the release of Tavern Talk until 4th July, 2024. 
Be sure to get them while you still can![/i]

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 New Languages Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/455f5f668e1b0d4a24428a3890576f37cea2ef6c.png[/img]

[h3][i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars. [/i][/h3]

Two months had passed since the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly. [b]We are thankful for all the feedback we received so far as we gradually update the game to what our community has voiced.[/b] Currently, we are trying our best to make Coffee Talk Episode 2 available in several different languages, with more coming later this year. 

[h3][b]Now Available in Bahasa Indonesia, Brazilian Portuguese, and Turkish! [/b][/h3]
[b]Enjoy serving coffee & tea of Coffee Talk to your favorite regulars in Bahasa Indonesia, Brazilian Portuguese, and Turkish.[/b] The first significant language update of the Coffee Talk Episode is here! We are releasing three languages simultaneously on Steam and other platforms. We hope that by reading the dialogues and stories of Coffee Talk Episode 2 in your native language, you will feel more familiar with the characters and understand more about the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/3f7451e1d2e9b8314ce03fa1f99a02ccae4c6770.gif[/img]
[b][i]In-game preview of the three new languages available now to play![/i][/b]

[h3][b]Languages Update Sale![/b][/h3]
Grab Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly on its first sale now 20% OFF! Take a copy for yourself or give them to your friend who you think would love to enjoy it in their native language. It's never too late to start brewing a new chapter with a cup of coffee (or tea if you want to keep it low on caffeine). ːctcoffeeː

[h3][b]Grab Coffee Talk Episode 2 here 20% OFF![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

[b] More updates will come later this year, so keep updated through our social media platforms! [/b] If you have encountered bugs, typos, or technical issues, you can hit us on the Steam discussion or join our community to get a faster response. Please eagerly wait for us to tease more after-release treatment soon.

notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2 Patch Notes v1.06
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/70e98a13554be845e846e6ff64904668ecf128af.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/h3]

[i][b]Following the game release after a few week, we are fixing any problems you have encountered. Thank you so much for reporting the issues and keeping still to wait for the latest updates~ [/b][/i]

CTHB v1.06 Steam for 17 May 2023 
+ Fix for Mac build.
+ Fix and change for some URL links in Tomodachill Stories.
+ Enlarge the recipe's font size (fix and polish UI).
+ Changed date size on newspaper app (fix and polish UI).
+ Fixed smartphone button anchor (fix and polish UI).
+ Fix press any key position (overlaps with Coffee Talk logo in 22:9 ratio) (fix and polish UI).
+ Fix enter name canvas in main menu (fix and polish UI).
+ Fixed latte art cursor calculation (fix and polish UI).
+ Fix the "Blood(ish) Red" achievement. [spoiler] For not triggering in Day 9, 14 when there's a chance to give Zobo to Hyde. [/spoiler]
+ Fix the rule for unlocking "Bad Review" achievement. [spoiler]In order to get the "Bad Review", you need to make 3x mistakes. [/spoiler]
+ Punctuation, grammar and typo fixes.
+ Fix some of the character animations.

[h3][b]Coffee Talk Episode 2 is OUT NOW![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

Please do look forward to what's to come for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly events and after-release treatment this year.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement for Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124308/ca156168c8218893e3f39398675b4cdbbfb26c71.jpg[/img]

[i]Greetings, Cafe Regulars.[/i]

After over two years after the first episode, we are excited to announce the final release date of Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly. [b]We have worked hard in the past few months to deliver the best experience, a fully-enhanced coffee-brewing simulation with more stories to unfold.[/b] Meet the regulars you all know and love, as well as new charming and quirky regulars. Be the barista that can solve their problems or you can just be there to listen to their stories. 

[b][h2]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is coming to you on April 20, 2023.[/h2][/b]

[b]Check out the release trailer announcement[/b]
[previewyoutube=A3NMtiw0eZo;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s not so far off from now and we hope you are excited as we are. There are more that we would love to talk about, but to make things more interesting, we asked Dio Mahesa, the Art Director of Coffee Talk, what the players would expect in the second episode. 

[i][b]“I’m excited to show you new interesting stories, new colorful characters with old characters from the prequel, and new drinks to explore! I hope you will enjoy the game.” [/b][/i]

Dio is proud of what has been produced for the past few months with the team, and he can’t wait to share more about his experience after the game releases. We can say that with certainty as we work behind the scenes with him, seeing all the new exciting content that will make the fans go wild after seeing how much things have been implemented. 

[b]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is a standalone visual novel game where you play as the barista in an alternative Seattle, where fantasy races are commonplace trying to make a living as a regular human does.[/b] Meet a diverse cast of characters – both old and new – listen to their stories, and serve them a warm drink or two. The way you serve would impact the overall story and how they will interact with you. Immerse yourself in the chill and cozy atmosphere of everyone’s favorite late-night coffee shop, Coffee Talk. 

[h3][b]Wishlist Coffee Talk Episode 2 on Steam![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly

[b]Follow us on social media and join our community to get into the latest updates of the game. [/b] Please look forward to more teasers in the future as we are nearing the release date. We look forward to seeing your reaction to the upcoming news!

Please stay safe and healthy, friends!
Fully brewed with love,

Coffee Talk Team. ːctfreyaː
